stories.title: WWE SummerSlam: Best matches, match picks and one huge Cody Rhodes prediction
stories.summary: Will Punk vs. Rhodes steal the weekend? And is this the end for Brock Lesnar? Watch SummerSlam Saturday and Sunday on ESPN Unlimited.

stories.title: 49ers' Pearsall to have season-ending surgery
stories.summary: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Ricky Pearsall is expected to have surgery on the nagging PCL injury that dates back to last season and will be out for the year, GM John Lynch told reporters Saturday.

stories.title: Bills' Gardner-Johnson carted off with leg injury
stories.summary: Bills safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson was carted to the locker room after suffering a lower-body injury during Saturday's training camp practice.

stories.title: Falcons lock up OL Bergeron on 4-year extension
stories.summary: The Falcons on Saturday signed starting left guard Matthew Bergeron to a four-year extension that sources said is worth $96 million with $60 million guaranteed.

stories.title: Giants suspend pay to Bader after scooter crash
stories.summary: The Giants are suspending payment to injured outfielder Harrison Bader after he aggravated his injured left foot in a scooter crash last weekend.
